summary: P0 Supabase migration verified. All 29 backend tests pass against the public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Corporate API is now fully Supabase-backed: tenant 'mood-corporate' (id=design-journey-cms), 8 cms_pages + 26 cms_sections + 1 navigation row introspected directly via SESSION_POOLER_URL. Form submissions (newsletter/contact/studio) persist rows in their respective tables; newsletter is idempotent (ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE) confirmed. Cache invalidation works and repopulates from DB; warm-cache hit is measurably faster than cold. No 'seed_data' import in routers/corporate.py or db/repository.py.
critical_code_review_comments: models.py / SQLAlchemy with create_type=False is correct (Blueprint owns DDL); no create_all() detected in corporate stack — good.
/api/corporate/cache/invalidate has no auth — fine for current scope but should be admin-gated before production exposure.
Email validation in NewsletterSubscribe and ContactForm uses plain str; consider EmailStr (pydantic[email]) for stricter validation.
repository._fetch_page filters status='published' (string compared against PgEnum). Works today, but if the enum value ever changes the silent miss would return 404 — consider asserting via enum.
Cache TTL is hard-coded (60s pages, 120s nav/list). Acceptable for MVP; consider env-driven override for ops tuning.
Studio slug generation lacks a uniqueness guard — two studios with the same name would collide on the deterministic slug. Add a uniqueness suffix or DB unique constraint before going live.
test_credentials: Not applicable — corporate APIs are public.
seed_data_creation: Test rows prefixed with TEST_ created in newsletter_subscribers, contact_submissions, studio_registrations via the public API. Safe to ignore or purge by prefix.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test suite at /app/backend/tests/test_corporate.py covers tenant, locales, pages list, page renderer for 6 locales + unknown locale fallback, page-specific sections (pricing/about/journal/blueprint/start-studio/platform/contact), 404 handling, navigation labels (it/fr/en-us) + footer groups, 15-type section registry, newsletter idempotency, contact reference uniqueness, studio slug determinism, cache invalidate + cold/warm timing, and static checks that seed_data is not imported. conftest.py loads REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env so pytest can run from anywhere. Supabase introspection (SESSION_POOLER_URL) confirms 8 pages + 26 sections + 1 navigation row for tenant id 51f9ab4d-1aaf-5b8b-b7a9-8a4c8f942a50.
